messages.subject: dashboard dynamic menuitems and widgets
parts:
Hi, I am hoping someone can point me in the right direction on how to use the menuItems to dynamically change widgets and outputs. Any guidance in the right direction would be greatly appreciated, thanks!

 

In my shinydashboard webapp, I would like my sidebarMenu menuItems to toggle what is being displayed in the dashboardSidebar and the dashboardBody at the same. That is, when a different menuItem is selected I want both the widgets and the plots displayed to change.

 

So in my prototype I would like only the “Graphs slider:” and “my_example_Graph” to be visible when the “Graphs” menuItem is selection. As expected, when the “Tables” menuItem is selected I want only the “Table slider:” and “my_example_Table” to be visible.

 

We have tried using tabItems() to toggle which tabItem is selected (e.g. “tabItem(‘first_page’,”), but this can only toggle either the sidebar or the body options.

 

Thanks!

James


Shiny App Code Below:

## prototype app.R ##


#Install shiny dashboard package: http://rstudio.github.io/shinydashboard/index.html

# install.packages("devtools")

require(devtools)


if("shinydashboard" %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"]){

  require(shinydashboard)

} else {

  devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinydashboard")

  require(shinydashboard)

}

require(shinydashboard); require(shiny)


header <- dashboardHeader(title = "Dynamic sidebar")


sidebar <- dashboardSidebar(

  sidebarMenu(

    menuItem("Graphs", tabName = "first_page", icon = icon("bar-chart-o")),

    menuItem("Tables", tabName = "second_page",icon = icon("th"))

  ),

  sliderInput("graph_slider", "Graphs slider:", min=1, max=10, value=2),

  sliderInput("table_slider", "Table slider:",  min=1, max=10, value=3)

)


body <- dashboardBody(tabItem(tabName = "Graphs",

                              fluidRow(

                                box(title = "my_example_Graph",

                                    plotOutput("graph")

                                )

                              )),  

                      tabItem(tabName = "Tables",

                              fluidRow(

                                box(title = "my_example_Table",

                                    tableOutput("table")

                                )

                              )

                      )

        )


ui <- dashboardPage(header, sidebar, body)


server <- function(input, output) {

  output$graph <- renderPlot({

    plot1 <- plot(1:input$graph_slider)

    return(plot1)

  })

  output$table <- renderTable({

    example_dt <- data.frame(num = 1:input$table_slider, 

                             alpha = letters[1:input$table_slider])

    return(example_dt)

  })

}


shinyApp(ui, server)

Thanks Joe, you got me started on the right path, I appreciate that! The same approach worked for the body, which was the second half of my question:

body <- dashboardBody(

fluidRow(
                     box(title = "my_example_Graph", width=15, height=15,
                         plotOutput("graph")
                     )

fluidRow(
                     box(title = "my_example_table", width=15, height=15,
                         # tableOutput("exampleTable")
                         plotOutput("table")
                     )
                   )
  )  
)
